title: AKKA YAKOBOONI WAAQAN WOLWOLLAANE
paragraphs: Eegi Yakobooni ganna gudda fula abuya isa Labanii taae, inni horii gudaafi, ijolle heddufi, hojjatoota heddulleni ineebifame. Duuba ato oboleesa isa Esaau, kha inni sobe eeba abaa irra fud’ate, sodaatelle akka Kanaaniti deebiu male herrege.

Kanaaniti diaannaani, Yakobooni hori heddu ufdura isaati erge akka qoonqo d’eeta. Jari ergani kaani dachae waan Yakobooni jed'e, “Oboleesi kanke Esau ya garre; inninu nama d'ibba afuri fud'ate fuula keesa si d'ufu jira”. Tana d'ageennaani Yakobooni nahe, lubbuuni d'ufte, Waaqa yaamate waan jed'e, “Ee Waaqa, Waaqa akhaakhu kiyya Abrahamutiifi abba kiyya Isaaqo, siti, ‘Lafafi worra keesaniti deebii, nagaya si guuta’ naani jed'e; naasufi jaalala ta atini naa, hojattu tante, garsiifte anini himmalleefi. Anini duri gaafa galaana Yordani taake, ule tiyya male, woma tokole inqabu; amma gumifi hori karra lama kana qaba. Amma si kad'ad'a, harka oboleesa kiyya Esau keesa na baasi. Anini insodaad'a, aka inni d'ufe nu ch'ufa had'e balleesu, nad'eenifi ijoollele. Ammo atini qara waan jette, Anini nagaya si guute si daraarse ijoolle heddu ta aka maansa galaana si tolcha jette.”

Galaana Yordaniitin baanani, Yakobooni kae nad'eeni isaatifi, hojjatu isatifi ijolle isa taakisiise, ufii koba eegeti hafe. Jennaani nami inni imbeenne d'ufe isaani wolwolaane, haga biiftuuni baatuti. Nami suni aka Yakobo indabsanne arge jennaani tafa d'ae miitati buqise. Inni waan Yakobooni jed'e, “Lafti ya bariite, gadi na lakisi, indeema. Yakobooni, Illakisu, haga atini na eebiftuti jed'eeni.” Namichi waan jed'eeni, “Maqaani ke eenu?” Jennaani inni, “Yakobo” jed'e. Namichi waan jed'eeni, “Maqaani ke armaa achi Yakoboniti. Atini ya Waaqafi namaani wolmorkitani lachu dabsatte, tanaafi maqaani kanke Israeli taha.” Yakobooni waan jed'e, “Ya Waaqaani fuula keesa wolargine iraa hafe.”

Akkuma Malikaani deemteni, Yakobooni Esau arge. Inni ufdiqeese isa duraati jilbiifate, duuba Esauuni naasufi haraarani isa fudhate, akka Waaqi guddo Yakobo eebise arge guddo maadefate. Yakobooni ijoole isa arginaan eeba Waaqa ta isa waliin jirtu arge. Duuba Yakobooni horii heddu Esauu kenne, wan isaan jed’e “Fuula kanke arguuni kiya, ak waan fuula Waaqa arge nati jirti, waan atini naasun na fudhateef. Horii anini sii dhufeen kana narra fudhadhuu waan Waaqo tola eeba isa naa kenneefi.” Eegi suni, Yakoboofi Esauuni nagayaan ganna heddu waliin fidamani.
